other_conditions: Must have a Post Graduate degree (M.Sc./MA) in basic science or a professional course with minimum 55% marks for General/OBC and 50% marks for SC/ST/Physically Handicapped/Visually Handicapped.
Candidates holding degrees such as B.Tech/M.Tech in biomedical sciences, B.Pharm/M.Pharm or D.Pharm are not eligible.
Upper age limit is 28 years, with relaxation up to five years for SC/ST/OBC/PH/VH and female candidates, and three years for OBC category.
Applicants must not be drawing any stipend, salary, or other financial assistance except leave salary during the fellowship.
benefits_summary: JRF recipients receive a monthly stipend of ₹31,000 for the first two years, an annual contingency grant of ₹20,000, and may be upgraded to SRF with a higher stipend.
